title: Steel's Create Kitchen Sink
description: A kitchen sink Create-centred Modpack without any questlines or fuss. Avoids bloat and same-function mods. Have fun!
body:
# Summary
This modpack is basically just a loose collection of Create Mods that we threw together for the release of Create: Aeronautics. Inside are all of our favourite mods, such as the food expansion Farmer's Delight and its various addons, or The Factory Must Grow (which we have stripped the electricity content of and replaced with Power Grid), as well as various QOL mods. FTBTeams is included for quick and easy teleportation. Recipes have been changed to integrate duplicate features, such as Farmer's Delight's Dough or Create Big Cannons and TFMG's Cast iron and Steel. Complexity in crafting is prioritized.

## Terrain additions
Terralith, Geophilic, and Tectonic have been included to spice up the world. We've readded diorite, granite, and andesite patches too.

## Backports
Spears and the Copper Age are backported!

## Not every Vanilla+ mod
I'm not a particularly big fan of block variant addons, or Quark, so you should expect to build the way you do in vanilla!

Feel free to use this Modpack as a base, no credit required. You can copy the KubeJS scripts if you'd like!
